_meta.description: Federal and state HR forms library for AI-Prowler HR module. All links sourced from official government websites.
_meta.disclaimer: Tax rates and form requirements change annually. Verify all links at IRS.gov, DOL.gov, and state agency sites.

W-4.name: Employee's Withholding Certificate
W-4.description: Employee completes to tell employer how much federal income tax to withhold from each paycheck. Required before first paycheck. Employer keeps on file — NOT filed with IRS.
W-4.penalty_if_missing: Employer must withhold at Single/0 (maximum) rate.
W-4.employee_instructions: This form tells your employer how much federal income tax to take out of your paycheck. Complete it based on your filing status and any adjustments. You can update it at any time.

I-9.name: Employment Eligibility Verification
I-9.description: Verifies identity and employment authorization for all employees hired in the US. Section 1 by employee on or before Day 1. Section 2 by employer within 3 business days. Employer retains — NOT filed with USCIS.
I-9.deadline: Section 1: Day 1. Section 2: Day 3 (3 business days from start)
I-9.section1_deadline: Day 1 — on or before first day of work
I-9.section2_deadline: Day 3 — within 3 business days of start date
I-9.penalty_section2: $272–$2,726 per form violation (paperwork). $698–$27,894 per knowingly unauthorized worker.
I-9.employee_instructions: You must complete the top portion of Form I-9 on or before your first day of work. Attest to your work authorization status. Bring original identity documents (not copies) to HR on Day 1.

list_a: Foreign passport with I-94 and I-20/DS-2019

CA-DE4.name: Employee's Withholding Allowance Certificate (California)
CA-DE4.description: California state income tax withholding form. Required for CA employees in addition to federal W-4. Determines state income tax withholding.
CA-DE4.penalty_if_missing: Without CA DE-4: employer withholds at state default rate.
CA-DE4.employee_instructions: California requires a separate state withholding form in addition to the federal W-4. Download, complete, sign, and upload a scan.

NY-IT2104.name: Employee's Withholding Allowance Certificate (New York)
NY-IT2104.description: New York state income tax withholding form. Required for NY employees in addition to federal W-4.

IL-W4.name: Employee's Illinois Withholding Allowance Certificate
IL-W4.description: Illinois state income tax withholding form. Required for IL employees in addition to federal W-4.

CO-DR0004.name: Colorado Employee Withholding Certificate
CO-DR0004.description: Colorado state income tax withholding form. Required for CO employees in addition to federal W-4.

MA-M4.name: Massachusetts Employee's Withholding Exemption Certificate
MA-M4.description: Massachusetts state income tax withholding form. Required for MA employees in addition to federal W-4.

FCRA-NOTICE.name: FCRA Disclosure and Authorization for Background Check
FCRA-NOTICE.description: Federal FCRA requires employers to provide a clear and conspicuous written disclosure to the candidate — SEPARATE from any other document — before running a background check. Must obtain signed authorization.
FCRA-NOTICE.deadline: Before any background check is run
FCRA-NOTICE.penalty: $1,000+ per willful violation. Class action exposure.
FCRA-NOTICE.employee_instructions: Before we run your background check, federal law requires us to provide this notice and get your written authorization.

HIPAA-NPP.name: HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices
HIPAA-NPP.description: If the company offers a group health plan, federal HIPAA law requires employees to receive a Notice of Privacy Practices within 30 days of plan enrollment. Employer must obtain signed acknowledgment.
HIPAA-NPP.condition: Only required if company offers group health plan
HIPAA-NPP.penalty: HHS OCR enforcement. Civil monetary penalties apply.

COBRA-INITIAL-NOTICE.name: COBRA General Notice (Initial)
COBRA-INITIAL-NOTICE.description: If the company offers a group health plan, COBRA requires providing an initial general notice to all new participants within 90 days of plan enrollment. Explains COBRA continuation rights.
COBRA-INITIAL-NOTICE.condition: Required if company offers group health plan (20+ employees for federal COBRA; states have mini-COBRA laws for smaller employers)
COBRA-INITIAL-NOTICE.penalty: $110/day for failure to provide required COBRA notices.

COBRA-QUALIFYING-EVENT.name: COBRA Qualifying Event Notice
COBRA-QUALIFYING-EVENT.description: On termination of an employee with health coverage, employer must notify the plan administrator within 30 days. Plan admin then sends the election notice to the employee within 14 days.

W-2.name: Wage and Tax Statement
W-2.description: Annual wage and tax statement sent to employees and filed with the SSA/IRS. Due to employees by January 31 each year.

941.name: Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return
941.description: Quarterly federal payroll tax return. Reports income taxes, Social Security, and Medicare taxes withheld from employees, plus employer's share of Social Security and Medicare taxes.

I9-SECTION3.name: I-9 Section 3 — Reverification
I9-SECTION3.description: Used when an employee's work authorization document expires. Employer must reverify before expiration. Do NOT reverify US citizens or Lawful Permanent Residents.
I9-SECTION3.deadline: Before expiration of work authorization document

FMLA-ELIGIBILITY.name: FMLA Eligibility Notice (WH-381)
FMLA-ELIGIBILITY.description: Required within 5 business days of an employee's FMLA leave request. Must include eligibility determination, rights and responsibilities, and any requirements for the leave.
FMLA-ELIGIBILITY.deadline: Within 5 business days of leave request

FMLA-DESIGNATION.name: FMLA Designation Notice (WH-382)
FMLA-DESIGNATION.description: Designates (or denies) the leave as FMLA. Must be provided within 5 business days of receiving sufficient information to make the determination.
FMLA-DESIGNATION.deadline: Within 5 business days of sufficient information
